segments.name: Gaming Accessories
segments.description: Designs, markets, and distributes gaming accessories including headsets, controllers, and peripherals for consoles, PCs, and mobile devices.
segments.evidence: The company operates in a single reportable segment, referred to as gaming accessories.

revenueModel.text: The company sells gaming accessories to consumers through major retailers and direct channels based on customer geographic location.
revenueModel.evidence: Our gaming accessories are distributed globally, with more than 475 thousand points of distribution, including major retailers such as Amazon, Argos, Best Buy, Target, and Walmart.

changes.text: In 2024, the company acquired Performance Designed Products, expanding its gaming controller and licensing portfolio.
changes.evidence: In 2024, we acquired Performance Designed Products ("PDP"), another leading gaming accessory brand with a robust slate of products, including gaming controllers for all major platforms and licensing deals with popular gaming and entertainment properties.

changes.text: In 2024, the company entered the racing simulation gaming accessory market.
changes.evidence: In 2024, we entered the racing simulation gaming accessory market.
